chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Mufaḍḍal, from Zayd al-Shaḥḥām, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
A man who killed a woman intentionally—he said: “If her family wishes to kill him, they may kill him, and they shall pay to his family half of the diyah.”

key_terms.يَقْتُلُوهُ: that they kill him in retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man intentionally kills a woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding intentional killing when a man kills a woman. It states that the woman's family may seek qisas by killing him, provided they pay half of the diyah to his family, reflecting the legal framework of retaliation and compensation in Shia fiqh.
